issues.detail: The instructions lack explicit handling of error scenarios and edge cases, such as installation failures or missing environment variables.

scenarios.name: uv-install-with-initial-password
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers almost all rubric items except the required export of ASTRBOT_DASHBOARD_INITIAL_PASSWORD, while Response A fails to meet any of the specified requirements.

scenarios.name: docker-deploy-loopback
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric while Response A is missing.

scenarios.name: configure-timezone-and-install-plugin
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully follows the rubric with correct commands and confirmation, while Response A omits the required astrbot conf set commands and does not confirm the plugin installation.
